levelPolicy: Core skills max rank, no talents/Scepter/Shard/facet modifiers. Base specials retained. No numbers scaled.
unitPolicy: Seconds and Dota units unchanged. Arena translation must be explicit. Percentages remain percentages.

juggernaut_blade_fury.name: Blade Fury
juggernaut_blade_fury.notes: 175 DPS, not175 per tick:35/tick every0.2s. Debuff immunity/80%magic resistance; strong dispel on end. Blade Dance can crit Blade Fury.

juggernaut_healing_ward.name: Healing Ward
juggernaut_healing_ward.notes: 5% maxHP per second, lasts24s, moves325, one enemy hit destroys. Do not convert to a fixed instant heal.

juggernaut_omnislash.name: Omnislash
juggernaut_omnislash.notes: Uses real attack damage and attack interval; grants invulnerability and basic dispel. No fixed official slash count.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.name: Freezing Field
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.notes: 250 is damage of EACH random explosion, not DPS.100 explosions over10s; only overlapping320-radius explosions damage opponent. Deterministic arena-wide DPS is an adaptation.

pudge_rot.name: Rot
pudge_rot.notes: Toggle with120DPS to self and nearby enemy,0mana/CD. Self-damage behavior must be implemented.

pudge_dismember.name: Dismember
pudge_dismember.notes: DPS=120+0.9*Pudge Strength;2.75s channel,6ticks; heals Pudge by damage dealt.

axe_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
axe_hunger.notes: PURE damage,24DPS. Slow applies only while target faces away. Ends if afflicted unit kills another unit.

axe_helix.name: Counter Helix
axe_helix.notes: Proc after4received attacks with0.3s internal CD, not random proc chance.

axe_culling.name: Culling Blade
axe_culling.notes: 475pure damage; official tooltip no health execution threshold in this snapshot. Reset cooldown +6s speed/armor if killing hero; permanent+2armor per successful hero kill.

sniper_shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
sniper_shrapnel.notes: 3charges,35s recharge; rawCooldown=0 is not unlimited free recast.1.2s delay,75DPS,10s area.

sniper_assassinate.name: Assassinate
sniper_assassinate.notes: 500 magical bonus plus an attack-damage component; ability raw damage type does not specify the attack component. Refresh on any hero kill. Mini-stun duration is not exposed in current feed.

anti_mage_mana_break.name: Mana Break
anti_mage_mana_break.notes: Burn40+4.5%target maxMP on attack; extra physical damage65%actual mana burned. Do not use fixed extra damage.

anti_mage_counterspell.name: Counterspell
anti_mage_counterspell.notes: Passive35%magic resistance and active1.3s targeted-spell block/reflection.

phantom_assassin_strike.name: Phantom Strike
phantom_assassin_strike.notes: 2charges,12s restore,0.1s cooldown;200bonus attack speed against enemy for3s.

phantom_assassin_coup.name: Coup de Grace
phantom_assassin_coup.notes: 17%attack/34%dagger chance gains Deadly Focus; NEXT attack consumes it for450%crit. Do not replace by every-N-attack crit if claiming exact.

drow_ranger_multishot.name: Multishot
drow_ranger_multishot.notes: 3waves of4arrows,140%attack per arrow; overlapping arrows from same wave do not imply4hits on same enemy. Current tooltip does not give precise per-target collision rule, keep documented adaptation.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
drow_ranger_marksmanship.notes: 40%proc,90bonus physical damage ignoring base armor, disabled within300 of enemy hero. Innate Precision Aura owns agility bonus, not this ability.

lina_fiery.name: Fiery Soul
lina_fiery.notes: Stacks per enemy hit by spell, not simply per cast;28attack speed and2.5%move per stack up to7,16s.

lion_finger.name: Finger of Death
lion_finger.notes: 850damage+25per kill. Current version also grants20s empowered melee form:250range,+40damage,+30movespeed and cleave. Do not omit form while claiming full current behavior.

earthshaker_fissure.name: Fissure
earthshaker_fissure.notes: 280damage+1.6s stun; impassable terrain wall lasts8s. Treating as projectile only misses wall.

earthshaker_totem.name: Enchant Totem
earthshaker_totem.notes: Adds400%BASE attack damage on next hit, not sets total multiplier to4x;14s buff;100bonus range.

earthshaker_echo.name: Echo Slam
earthshaker_echo.notes: 180initial+110per echo; real heroes create2echoes; echo interaction with same originating unit not explicit in feed. No fixed official total damage.

mirana_starstorm.name: Starstorm
mirana_starstorm.notes: 300initial then80%=240secondary to closest within675. RawDuration10 is not attack channel length.

mirana_arrow.name: Sacred Arrow
mirana_arrow.notes: 360base +up to180distance bonus; stun0.01..5s scaled up to1500Dota units, not always maximum stun.

sven_cleave.name: Great Cleave
sven_cleave.notes: Cleave90%attack to secondary enemies. No extra damage to lone primary target in1v1; utility only against wards/summons or multi-target modes.

sven_strength.name: God's Strength
sven_strength.notes: Bonus BASE attack190% for30s plus40%slow resistance; avoid multiplying all bonus damage.

zeus_arc.name: Arc Lightning
zeus_arc.notes: One opponent receives one hit absent other valid bounce targets; do not bounce repeatedly on same lone hero.

windranger_shackle.name: Shackleshot
windranger_shackle.notes: Needs tree/enemy behind target:3.25ssuccess vs0.6sfailure. Arena boundary treated as tree is explicit adaptation.

windranger_powershot.name: Powershot
windranger_powershot.notes: Charge up to1s for470damage; premature release scales damage;40%slow3s.

windranger_focus.name: Focus Fire
windranger_focus.notes: 500bonus attack speed,25%attack damage reduction for20s on chosen target.

shadow_fiend_raze.name: Shadowraze
shadow_fiend_raze.notes: 280+2*current souls+80*target existing raze stacks.200fixed center distance,250radius. Raw official page currently exposes only first Shadowraze ability; do not invent missing secondary variants.

shadow_fiend_feast.name: Feast of Souls
shadow_fiend_feast.notes: In1v1 collects3souls from opponent once; alive owner souls are lost when8s effect ends. Necromastery innate required for full soul system.

shadow_fiend_requiem.name: Requiem of Souls
shadow_fiend_requiem.notes: 160damage per intersecting soul-line; up to20lines. Fear0.6s/line capped2.15. Soul-based/death-trigger behavior requires innate Necromastery.

storm_spirit_remnant.name: Static Remnant
storm_spirit_remnant.notes: Point-targeted remnant WALKING at300speed;0.75activation delay,12slifetime,235trigger radius,300damage radius,280damage.

storm_spirit_ball.name: Ball Lightning
storm_spirit_ball.notes: Use explicit formula in description/specials: activation25+7.5%maxMP; travel each100DotaUnits costs10+.65%maxMP,14damage per100distance. Raw mana_costs30 conflicts; do not use flat30.

queen_of_pain_scream.name: Scream Of Pain
queen_of_pain_scream.notes: 345damage; reflects25%of damage dealt to heroes back to caster.

queen_of_pain_sonic.name: Sonic Wave
queen_of_pain_sonic.notes: 625PURE damage over knockback1.4s,350knockback; do not apply625each0.1stick.

witch_doctor_cask.name: Paralyzing Cask
witch_doctor_cask.notes: Lone enemy receives one100damage/0.8sstun hit if no other valid bounce target. No self-bounce.

witch_doctor_maledict.name: Maledict
witch_doctor_maledict.notes: 30DPS12s plus every4s40%ofHP lost since curse began; not flat burst.

witch_doctor_death_ward.name: Death Ward
witch_doctor_death_ward.notes: Current official damage type PURE (code4),120per ward attack,8schannel. Ward attack interval absent from hero feed; must label any chosen interval as arena adaptation or verify official unit data.

tidehunter_shell.name: Kraken Shell
tidehunter_shell.notes: Passive75flat physical attack block; active doubles block to150for4s,selfslow40%.30CD/45mana; strong dispel at450received damage,7sreset. Not a purely passive slot.

tidehunter_anchor.name: Anchor Smash
tidehunter_anchor.notes: Real attack +200bonus physical; radius attackRange+225,enemy attack damage-40%6s.
